description: Create a job for a customer. With only a customer_id it arrives unscheduled. Requires a full-access Housecall Pro API key. Add line items with hcp_add_job_line_items and book it with hcp_schedule_job_appointment, which schedules the job as it dispatches the visit. A job's description comes from its line items - it cannot be set directly.

address_id.description: Service address id (adr_...). Optional: a job can be created without one.

name: hcp_create_job
